trigger.note: Base spin (ST1) carrying pid 666 opens the bonus chain: a Wheel block (ST2, the collect settlement burst) -> the NewFreespin granted session (ST126). 203/203 ST126 freespin blocks are preceded by an ST2 wheel block; the wheel block is preceded by an ST1 round carrying pid 666 (sometimes alongside a payline pid).
